title: HotbarPriorityChanger
description: A mod that can change your hotbar slots' priority
body:
# HotbarPriorityChanger
![Time](https://hackatime-badge.hackclub.com/U0922GMGGTU/HotbarPriorityChanger)

This mod allows you to change your hotbar priority, what [Marlowww](https://www.youtube.com/@Marlowww)
described the video [How Your Hotbar Order Impacts Minecraft PVP](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RVmQnDtNxKo)
without having to reorder your entire hotbar.

Configure the mod using [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
\
The upper the slot, the bigger priority it has.
